'''Sembla''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]. An isolated world, it featured [[Temperature/Legends|warm]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and shallow [[Water/Legends|seas]] as well as archipelagos of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] islands. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the nomadic, low-technology [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammal]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Vurk/Legends|Vurks]], and it also hosted ancient underwater ruins thought to be of non-Vurk origin.

Sembla was a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], with the Tionese [[Slavery/Legends|enslaving]] the Vurks. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, during the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], one of the opposing factions convinced the Vurks of Sembla to let it harvest the planet's rare [[Coral/Legends|corals]] and [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] in exchange for gifting the natives simple tools and textiles. Sembla remained outside the borders of the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and escaped [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] attention afterward, with neither the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] nor the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] extending to it membership invitations.

==Description==
Sembla was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TCWCG" /> located in the [[Sembla system/Legends|Sembla system]]. It was situated in the [[Mahrusha sector/Legends|Mahrusha sector]], a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Between [[25,126 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]], the planet was linked via a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Janodral Mizar system/Legends|Janodral Mizar]] and [[Yutusk system/Legends|Yutusk systems]];<ref name="TEA" /> however, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Swarm War]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> of [[36 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Sembla was an isolated world that lay off the majority of [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] routes.<ref name="NEGAS" />

Circled by four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and possessing standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], Sembla completed one [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] every 274 [[Local day/Legends|local days]], each of which was thirty-two [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long. The climate on Sembla was [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]], and its surface featured [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and shallow, warm [[Water/Legends|seas]] as well as archipelagos of rocky [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] islands, the latter of which had points of high elevation above the sea level.<ref name="TCWCG" /> By the time of the Swarm War, the volcanic ridges dividing Sembla's seas were still slowly forming continents.<ref name="NEGAS" />

The warmest of Sembla's oceans were home to vast gardens of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] as well as<ref name="TCWCG" /> an abundance of<ref name="In Bad Faith" /> growths of<ref name="TCWCG" /> rare<ref name="In Bad Faith" /> and valuable [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> By approximately [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the missions "The Reefs of Sembla" and "In Bad Faith" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> some of Sembla's enormous coral reefs had remained undisturbed for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], and a [[Species/Legends|species]] of Semblan [[Semblan eel|eel]] resided there.<ref name="The Reefs of Sembla" />

==History==
===On the Republic's periphery===
Between 25,126 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[25,116 BBY]], the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] [[Xim's Expansionist Period|expanded]] to include Sembla,<ref name="TEA" /> with the Tionese considering<ref name="XimWeek">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> the native<ref name="TCWCG" /> [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] species "worthy" and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaving]] it.<ref name="XimWeek" /> Sembla was located in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around 3643 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] traveled to Sembla in order to study the planet's coral reefs. They spent several pleasant hours exploring the formations in a [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] and discovered a new species of [[Eel/Legends|eel]] hiding there.<ref name="The Reefs of Sembla" /> Around the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual likewise affiliated with either the Republic or the Sith Empire also voyaged to Sembla. There, the individual spoke with the native Vurks and successfully convinced them to let their government harvest the planet's rare corals and crystals in exchange for tributes of simple tools and textiles.<ref name="In Bad Faith" />
{{Endgame}}

===End of the Republic===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sembla was situated outside the borders of the Republic;<ref name="TEA" /> however, by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">{{CSWECite|I|137|Concorkill, Sweitt}} establishes that [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]] was a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] during the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Vurk [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]] nevertheless served as a Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]].<ref name="CSWE Concorkill">{{CSWECite|I|137|Concorkill, Sweitt}}</ref> Sembla changed little between the disestablishment of the Republic in 19 BBY and the rise of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, and it did not receive much [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] attention.<ref name="NEGAS" />

The planet escaped the attention of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that began in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], and neither the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] nor its successor, the Galactic Alliance, extended a membership invitation to Sembla due to the low number of its native Vurks off-planet. At some point no earlier than 36 ABY, Sembla was described in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of the galaxy that was based on the research notes of [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Vurk/Legends}}
[[File:ColemanTrebor-TLC.jpg|thumb|right|290px|Sembla was home to the Vurk species, including the Jedi Master Coleman Trebor.]]
Sembla was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Vurk species, which constituted one hundred percent of the planet's population. Amphibious<ref name="TCWCG" /> [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]]<ref name="NEGAS" /> who spoke the [[Semblan/Legends|Semblan]] [[Language/Legends|language]], the Vurks had a society organized into nomadic tribes with no overarching government. Large Vurk family units frequently migrated en masse across Sembla's surface, easily transitioning between the depths of the planet's seas and the heights of its islands.<ref name="TCWCG" /> The Vurk society did not feature heavy industry, and the species did not develop space travel on its own,<ref name="NEGAS" /> with the Vurks not finding practical use even for their homeworld's native corals and crystals.<ref name="In Bad Faith" /> Although galactic survey teams originally considered the Vurks to be primitive,<ref name="TCWCG" /> a view that eventually spread to the rest of the galaxy, the species was in fact highly intelligent and had a well-developed philosophical tradition<ref name="NEGAS" /> that valued personal integrity, individual freedom, and honesty.<ref name="TCWCG" />

The population of the Sembla [[Star system/Legends|system]] around 25 ABY numbered between five hundred million and one billion.<ref name="TEA" /> Sembla's exports to the wider galaxy included [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and water, while technology was imported on the planet from off-world. [[Miner/Legends|Miners]] from off-planet also frequently targeted Sembla's coral and crystal deposits. Vurks who left Sembla commonly became scouts or [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], with Vurks of [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] origins sometimes becoming [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]], a Vurk who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the time of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the Clone Wars<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|colemantrebor|Trebor, Coleman}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> hailed from Sembla.<ref name="DB" />

==Locations==
Due to the nomadic nature of Sembla's native Vurks, there were few permanent settlements on the planet, and by the time of the Swarm War the species did not have any memories of ever having had such settlements. However, ancient underwater ruins that did not appear to have been made by the Vurks had been found along Sembla's equator.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sembla was first mentioned in [[Marcus Hearn]]'s [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]''.<ref name="IllustratedCompanion">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]''</ref> The planet was given its first visual depiction through an illustration by [[Ian Fullwood]] and included in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sembla system, and therefore the planet itself, in grid square S-5.<ref name="TEA" /> Sembla was mentioned in two Crew Skill missions of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="The Reefs of Sembla" /><ref name="In Bad Faith" /> One of the missions was initially only available to Sith Empire&ndash;aligned players, but both this restriction<ref name="In Bad Faith" /> and the information regarding both missions' outcome were later removed from the game.<ref name="The Reefs of Sembla" /><ref name="In Bad Faith" />
